title: KBS1 방송종료 + 애국가 1절 (news end, closedown, anthem)
notes: the end of a Korean broadcasting day: the newsreader signing off against a night skyline, the weather caption 전국 한두 차례 비, the card thanking everyone who watched this late, then 애국가 over the Taegukgi, a sunrise on water, city aerials, egrets on a nest, a waterfall, a child laughing and a lit dome
